items.text: New Orleans (early week): missed last game - C Erik McCoy, RT Taliese Fuaga, OT Asim Richards, CB Martin Emerson Jr., LB Pete Werner (hamstring), S Justin Reid. TE Juwan Johnson (hamstring) being evaluated. IR - DT Bryan Bresee, DT Christen Miller, G Dillon Radunz. Tyler Shough (non-throwing hand) starts.

Cincinnati (early week, after MNF): missed last game - G Dalton Risner, S Kyle Dugger (quad), WR Andrei Iosivas (thumb), CB Jalen Davis. IR - LB Oren Burks (groin), TE Erick All Jr. (ACL). LB Swayze Bozeman, G Brian Parker II activated. Burrow healthy.
